sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale International Distribution of Acetate Eyeglass Frames

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (continental/Napoleonic tradition); the SCSp is governed by the amended Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies and was introduced by the Law of 23 July 2016, deliberately blending common-law limited partnership features such as contractual flexibility and non-resident unlimited partners.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg–United States Double Taxation Agreement (DTA, 1996, as amended by the 2009 Protocol)
Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures (MLI, 2017)
Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Apostille Convention)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Consolidated Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing (AML/CFT Law), as amended, including by the Laws of 3 July 2019, 25 March 2020, 9 November 2021 and 22 December 2023; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE Law), as amended by the Law of 27 July 2023 restricting public access in line with CJEU joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 14 May 2019 on the RBE filing procedure; CSSF Regulation 12-02, as amended.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or extract of the home-country commercial register of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a party; otherwise Consular Legalization via the Luxembourg embassy or consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (certificat de non-faillite / life certificate) of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Registry or licensed corporate services provider

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all shareholders, partners and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent public authority or licensed notary of the country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill, bank statement or notarized domicile certificate) for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider / credit institution / licensed notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Tax Residence (attestation de résidence fiscale) of each UBO above the 25% threshold and of the general partner

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence (EDD) on all UBOs, shareholders and the general partner against: (i) the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (ii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (Council Regulation (EU) 269/2014 and 833/2014, as implemented in Luxembourg); (iii) the OFAC SDN list; (iv) the Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (Cellule de Renseignement Financier, CRF) typology alerts and guidelines; and (v) the FATF high-risk and monitored jurisdictions list. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), their family members and close associates as defined by FATF Recommendations 12, 22 and 23 are subject to mandatory EDD, written source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation, and senior-management approval before the engagement is accepted. Beneficial ownership must be established by piercing each intermediary entity until natural persons are identified.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers portal — lbr.lu (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés, RCS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal entity name must be expressed in Latin script and must be clearly distinguishable from all existing and pending RCS entries. Non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic) must be transliterated or romanized into a form usable in French, German or Luxembourgish administrative practice. The name must contain or be followed by the statutory legal-form designation 'SCSp' or 'Société en Commandite Spéciale' exactly as registered; no translated or misleading suffixes may be added.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: banque, bank, banking (prohibited without CSSF authorization)
assurance, insurance, réassurance (prohibited without Commissariat aux Assurances authorization)
fonds d'investissement, fonds commun de placement, UCITS, SICAV, SIF, RAIF (investment-fund tokens reserved to CSSF-registered regulated funds)
fiduciaire, trustee, trust (fiduciary and trust tokens requiring CSSF or ministerial prior approval)
SA, SARL, SCA, SCS, SECA, société anonyme, société à responsabilité limitée (misleading statutory-form suffixes inconsistent with the SCSp are prohibited)
Luxembourg, state, gouvernement, national (tokens implying state affiliation or sovereignty require prior State approval)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon RCS/LBR refusal, the incorporator, acting through the Luxembourg notary, may: (1) submit a written reconsideration request to the LBR within 15 calendar days, attaching evidence of distinctiveness, trademark coexistence agreements or explanatory memoranda addressing the objection; (2) if the refusal is confirmed, lodge a petition before the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg (commercial chamber) within one month of notification of the refusal, in accordance with the Code of Commerce and LBR administrative rules; (3) in parallel, reserve an alternative cleared name to avoid transactional delay. Where the refusal relates to sensitive tokens, a prior ministerial or CSSF authorization may be requested ex ante; the notary then issues a negative clearance certificate (certificat de non-confusion) confirming the final name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible. An SCSp must have a registered office situated in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg; there is no statutory requirement for a separate operational premises for a low-risk wholesale trading company. A licensed domiciliation agent or regulated corporate services provider (professionnel du secteur financier) may supply a virtual office comprising a Luxembourg street address, mail handling and registered-address service. However, the Luxembourg tax administration and the CRF expect genuine economic substance commensurate with the activity, including local bank account, administrative records, management decision-making and, if the SCSp files for a tax ruling or claims treaty benefits, resident personnel or substantive local service arrangements. A pure mailbox without contractual substance support is not acceptable.

stage_1.physical_inspection_likelihood: Maximum 20% probability within the first three operating years for a low-risk wholesale optical frames distributor with standard SWIFT/platform payment rails; the probability increases to approximately 40-50% if the SCSp claims pass-through treatment for Luxembourg tax purposes, applies for an advance tax decision, or has non-resident PEPs among the UBOs. Unannounced CRF and RCS inspections are triggered mainly by inconsistent filings, rapid turnover of UBOs, or high-risk payment-rail flags.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (EUR 250-400 hourly rate; fixed fee customary for standard SCSp formation)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of formation (acte constitutif) and mandatory notary consultation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff (Grand-Ducal Regulation of 9 January 1976, as amended)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS name clearance and company registration filing (LBR online portal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official LBR tariff (EUR 75 registration fee plus supporting document fees)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers / Administration de l'enregistrement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory RBE registration fee set by the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 14 May 2019

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in the Official Gazette (RESA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Official Gazette of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations, RESA)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille and consular legalization bundle (5 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs / designated Apostille authority; Luxembourg consular post where applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Public tariff per document (USD 12-150 per Apostille depending on issuing state; consular and translation fees additional)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translations into French, German or English
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark (EUR 80-150 per page, depending on language pair and urgency)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office, domiciliation and corporate-substance package (year 1)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed corporate services provider (CSP) / domiciliation agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for non-regulated SCSp domiciliation (EUR 2,000-3,000 per annum including AML KYC file maintenance)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT PEP and sanctions database screening and compliance tool subscription
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML data provider (e.g., integrated World-Check / OFAC SDN screening platform)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark annual subscription for one low-risk wholesale entity, its shareholders and UBO panel

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended, Articles 902-1 to 902-9 (creating the SCSp); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 on the Register of Beneficial Owners; Law of 2 September 2011 on access to professions, as amended; the SCSp is administered by its general partner(s) acting as gérant and has no corporate board unless the partnership agreement provides otherwise.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Guichet unique des entreprises, 11 rue de la Grève, L-1643 Luxembourg; filings via the LBR e-filing portal (guichet.lu / lbr.lu).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Limited Partnership Agreement (contrat de société / statuts) executed either as a notarial deed or as a private deed signed by all partners, followed by RCS registration and publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to the SCSp; the partnership agreement freely fixes capital contributions and no escrow account is required by law. Contributions are evidenced through capital accounts, and in-kind contributions must be described in the deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Limited Partnership Agreement of [Name] SCSp is hereby ratified and adopted in full. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the subscriptions of the general partner and the limited partners recorded in Schedule A are accepted, and each partner's capital contribution is deemed duly agreed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office (siège social) of the Partnership is fixed at [address], L-1234 Luxembourg, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, and the general partner is instructed to execute the relevant lease or domiciliation agreement. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed gérant with exclusive management authority and is authorized to open bank accounts and to complete the RCS, RESA, VAT and beneficial-owner registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Verification and reservation of the corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - RCS e-search and name reservation module, guichet.lu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the RCS database for identical or confusingly similar names; the chosen name must include the suffix 'SCSp' or 'Société en commandite spéciale' and must comply with Article 902-3 of the 1915 Law. File the name reservation request through the LBR portal or instruct the Luxembourg notary to verify the name; reservations are held for the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name with SCSp suffix
Corporate purpose description (wholesale distribution of ophthalmic eyewear frames, ISIC 4646)
Identification details of the general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry refuses the name as identical or misleading, submit a revised name containing a distinctive element; the reservation fee is applied to the new application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Limited Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (optional authentic deed) or partners acting under private signature
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the partnership agreement in French, German or English containing: corporate name; registered office (siège social) in Luxembourg; corporate purpose limited to wholesale international distribution of acetate eyeglass frames; duration; capital contribution clauses for the general and limited partners; profit-sharing, distribution and liquidation provisions; and full management powers of the gérant. All partners must sign the deed; corporate partners must annex an authorizing board resolution.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of all natural-person partners
RCS extract or equivalent foreign registration certificate for corporate partners
Proof of residential or registered address of each partner
Draft limited partnership agreement
Power of attorney for the notary or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiencies are cured by a supplementary act (acte modificatif) signed by all partners before the RCS filing; substantive errors require unanimous partner consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - RCS, Guichet unique électronique des entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed deed and annexed documents via the LBR e-filing portal or through the notary. The filing must include the appointment statement of the gérant, proof of good repute (non-bankruptcy certificate), proof of the registered office (lease or domiciliation letter) and the AML/KYC file of each partner. Pay the statutory fee and obtain the RCS registration number and extract; the record will note the absence of legal personality and the identity of the general partner.
required_dossiers: Executed limited partnership agreement
Acceptance statement of the gérant (Article 902-5)
Certificate of good repute and non-bankruptcy of the gérant
Lease or domiciliation certificate for the registered office
AML/KYC identification file for all partners
Initial beneficial-owner information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a notice of deficiency, respond within 30 days with supplementary documents or corrected signatures; upon rejection, re-file the corrected deed and obtain a new registration number, preserving the original presentation date where possible.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the RESA electronic gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The RCS automatically forwards the registration data for publication in the RESA. Verify the published notice on the LBR portal and retain the publication certificate; third-party opposability of the deed runs from the date of this publication.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract (auto-forwarded)
Incorporation deed (auto-forwarded)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request rectification of clerical errors through the RCS registry; substantive challenges to the published deed are brought before the RCS supervisory judge under Article 24 of the Law of 19 December 2002.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) - VAT registration office; Administration des contributions directes (ACD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the VAT registration form via the AEDT e-portal to obtain the Luxembourg VAT number (LU + 8 digits) required for intra-community wholesale transactions of optical frames. Register the SCSp with the ACD to obtain a national tax number for pass-through reporting of each partner's distributive share, and confirm whether Luxembourg or foreign partners are subject to withholding or reporting.
required_dossiers: RCS extract
Limited partnership agreement
List of partners with tax residence certificates
Description and projected turnover of the wholesale activity
Bank account details of the partnership
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the AEDT queries the filing, submit corroborating partner statements and the activity description; late VAT registration is curable by filing within the grace period and paying only the administrative late fee, since the SCSp itself is not subject to subscription tax (taxe d'abonnement).

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE); Ministry of the Economy - Service des autorisations d'établissement (where applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the beneficial-owner declaration with the RBE within 30 days of RCS registration and appoint a data-access officer. Verify whether an establishment authorization is required under the Law of 2 September 2011: a pure wholesale SCSp with no Luxembourg warehouse, no employees and no fixed sales installation is outside the authorization scope; the authorization becomes mandatory if the SCSp later opens premises or hires staff. If triggered, submit the application via guichet.lu together with the gérant's professional credentials.
required_dossiers: Beneficial-owner declaration forms (RBE)
Identity documents of all beneficial owners
Proof of economic activity (turnover and premises evidence)
Professional qualification certificates of the gérant (only if establishment authorization is triggered)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct incomplete RBE filings within the regulatory grace period; an establishment-authorization refusal may be appealed to the Minister of the Economy and thereafter to the Administrative Tribunal within three months.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy, Direction générale de l'industrie - consulted for information only; no industrial manufacturing license applies to wholesale distribution of ophthalmic eyewear frames (ISIC 4646).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - no statutory operating or manufacturing permit is required for the wholesale trading of acetate eyeglass frames; the general commercial establishment authorization ('autorisation d'établissement') under the Law of 2 September 2011 applies only if the SCSp operates a fixed warehouse with employees in Luxembourg.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement, Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category D - no EIA required): dry warehousing and wholesale re-distribution of acetate optical frames do not meet the Annex IV/V thresholds of the amended Law of 22 May 2008 on environmental impact assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process discharges generated: no process wastewater, no VOC-emitting production lines, no hazardous waste streams. Residual compliance duties: EC Regulation 1907/2006 (REACH) Article 33 communication for imported frames containing SVHCs above 0.1% w/w; packaging waste obligations under the Law of 21 March 2012; municipal waste collection contracts with the local commune.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety and emergency-evacuation certification from the Administration de l'incendie et des secours (AIS) and the competent commune for any Luxembourg storage premises; structural load clearance for warehouse racking from the municipal building inspectorate; occupational health and safety inspection by the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) under Book IV of the Labor Code whenever employees are engaged; electrical installation verification prior to occupation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) for direct taxes; Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT. Unified access via MyGuichet.lu and the AEDT e-CDF electronic VAT portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the SCSp and obtain the RCS registration number and national identification number (matricule) through the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR). Step 2: Submit the standard VAT registration form (Formulaire 644) to the AEDT via the e-CDF/MyGuichet platform to obtain a Luxembourg VAT identification number (LU + 8 digits). Step 3: Because the SCSp is fiscally transparent for income tax, no separate corporate income tax file is opened in the partnership's name with the ACD; each partner is registered and taxed in their own capacity. The SCSp nonetheless files periodic VAT returns and, where applicable, Intrastat and EC Sales Lists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists; fiscal transparency of the SCSp is mandatory under Luxembourg domestic law (confirmed by the law of 12 July 2013 and circulars of the ACD). Available mechanisms: (a) election to be treated as a taxable person for VAT purposes, which is automatic for the SCSp acting in its own name; (b) VAT grouping election ('assujetti unique') under Article 60 VLL; (c) commercial-status option under the law of 10 August 1915 (as amended), automatically deemed for the SCSp; (d) ATAD-compliant hybrid mismatch disallowance elections and documentation in accordance with the law of 21 December 2017 implementing EU Directive 2016/1164.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Luxembourg Value Added Tax (taxe sur la valeur ajoutée) — EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC transposed by the VAT Law of 12 February 1979
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual turnover threshold for the small-business exemption (Article 57 VLL) applicable only to established domestic taxable persons; zero registration threshold for non-established foreign suppliers — registration required from the first taxable supply in/into Luxembourg.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or mandatory B2B e-invoicing regime exists. Mandatory B2G e-invoicing applies under the law of 7 November 2019, requiring invoices to public-sector buyers via the PEPPOL network (Peppol BIS 3.0). B2B e-invoicing is optional; the AEDT accepts structured electronic files. Large taxpayers must maintain and provide, on audit demand, the Luxembourg Standard Audit File for Tax (FEC/L-SAF-T) covering accounting records and VAT-relevant transactional data. VAT returns and EC Sales Lists are filed electronically through the e-CDF portal with prescribed API/interoperability requirements only for approved software vendors.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods physically dispatched or transported to a destination outside the European Union qualify for the 0% export exemption under Article 41(1) VLL, provided the supplier holds adequate transport evidence proving removal from EU territory within 90 days. Intra-Community supplies to a customer holding a valid EU VAT identification number are also zero-rated with corresponding EC Sales List reporting. The SCSp must be able to demonstrate that title and risk passed to the buyer abroad, that payment corresponds to invoiced amounts, and that all transport documentation is coherent.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD/Minimum Reference Number) lodged via the EU Customs Single Window
Bill of Lading, CMR waybill or Air Waybill evidencing physical removal from EU territory
Proof of payment — SWIFT wire transfer confirmation or Inward Remittance Certificate from the acquiring bank
Customer's valid EU VAT ID certificate (for intra-Community supplies)
EC Sales List (recapitulative statement) and Intrastat declaration where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No statutory FX repatriation deadline exists in Luxembourg; the 180-day commercial payment term should be contractually documented to respect transfer-pricing and arm's-length standards. Lacunae in export proof trigger immediate reversal of zero-rating, VAT reassessment at 17%, late-payment interest at 0.6% per month, and administrative fines up to EUR 5,000 per offense under Article 59 VLL. Fraudulent or fictitious export claims constitute criminal tax fraud punishable by imprisonment and/or fines up to four times the evaded VAT, with a retroactive assessment period extended to 10 years. The AEDT and Customs authorities routinely cross-check MRN customs data against VAT returns and partner/shareholder records.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) in coordination with the European Central Bank (ECB); banking and AML/CFT supervision by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) under the EU free movement of capital framework (TFEU Articles 63-66)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg operates under full capital and current account convertibility within the euro area. There is no Luxembourg exchange control legislation, no mandatory approval for cross-border capital movements, and no profit remittance licensing for a pass-through SCSp. Distributions to non-resident limited partners are not subject to Luxembourg withholding tax at the partnership level. The only operative constraints are EU AML/KYC verification, sanctions screening, FATCA/CRS reporting, and counterparty bank internal risk policy. Convertibility risk is negligible; EUR-USD and EUR-CNH liquidity is unrestricted.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Luxembourg and the euro area impose no statutory surrender requirement, no repatriation timeline, and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. The SCSp may freely retain USD, CHF, CNH or other trade receipts in foreign-currency accounts at CSSF-regulated banks; only standard BCL monetary statistics reporting applies to balance-sheet data, not to individual trade flows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Multi-Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkeess)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with Cash Management and Trade Finance

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low-Medium. Luxembourg-authorised EMIs offer faster onboarding and Platform Pay integration, but most restrict partnerships with non-resident UBOs, impose monthly transaction velocity caps incompatible with wholesale invoice settlement, and cannot support documentary LC issuance. UK or offshore EMIs are not passportable into Luxembourg post-Brexit; platform pay balances must be swept daily to the SCSp's own CSSF-regulated bank account to avoid undisclosed payment-institution escrow risk. Recommended use: secondary collection of platform pay receipts only, with BIL or BCEE as the primary clearing bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Effective mandate: at least one physical or video-verified interview of the general partner's authorised signatories and all beneficial owners exceeding 25% is required for an SCSp. CSSF AML rules (Regulation 12-02 as amended, 5AMLD, eIDAS) permit qualified video identification, but BIL, BCEE and BGL BNP Paribas commonly exercise discretion to require a physical compliance meeting in Luxembourg for a newly formed partnership with non-resident UBOs. Remote opening is theoretically possible with eIDAS-qualified e-signatures plus an e-UBO extract from the Luxembourg RCS, yet the prudent assumption is one in-person closing session before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated SCSp (less than 12 months) with no audited financials and non-resident UBOs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified RCS registration excerpt, signed limited partnership agreement and articles, e-UBO registry extract, UBO passports and proof of address, source of funds bank statements covering all initial contributions, tax residence certificates of each partner, and an AML self-certification executed by the general partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border wholesale invoicing to optical distributors with invoices disproportionate to company size and intercompany flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master distribution agreements with Hoya, EssilorLuxottica-affiliated or regional wholesalers, purchase orders, supplier invoices, carrier waybills, EU customs declarations referencing HS 9003.11 and 9003.19, stock movement reports, aged receivables ledger, and a written explanation of any intra-group counterparty relationships.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection or pay-out routed through third-party pooled accounts, PayPal, or a non-Luxembourg EMI
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contribution confirmations signed by each limited partner, original bank references from the originating financial institutions, itemised source-of-wealth breakdown, notarised signature specimens, and a documented undertaking that all operational disbursements will be settled exclusively from the SCSp's own BCL-regulated bank account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: USD clearing via a US correspondent with potential OFAC or EU sanctions hits on distributors in optional jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Denied-party screening results captured at onboarding and at each payment date, a jurisdiction risk memorandum, end-customer KYC files, EU dual-use export licence analysis confirming non-applicability to optical frames, an OFAC compliance attestation, and the routing of all USD through a single named New York correspondent with no more than one intermediary bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign partners transmit via SWIFT MT103 (MT202 for large aggregated contributions) to the SCSp's EUR or USD account at a CSSF-regulated credit institution. Field 50F must mirror the exact partner of record; remittance information must cite 'Capital Contribution - [name] SCSp - LPA Article [X]'. For USD, use the receiving bank's New York correspondent clearing line with no more than one intermediate bank. Pre-funding verification: signed contribution clause, RCS filing evidence where applicable, and FATCA/CRS classification codes. Recommended ISO 20022/EBA purpose code: CAPC (capital contribution) or MISC; never code as GIFT or TRADE. Same-day EUR value requires instruction by 13:30 CET; USD value follows New York cut-offs.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer in EUR for supplier invoices under EUR 100,000; (ii) SWIFT MT103 for USD, CHF and CNH settlements; (iii) Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700) with at-sight or deferred payment opened by the SCSp's bank for frame manufacturing purchases from Asian acetate and hinge suppliers; (iv) documentary collections (CAD) for first-time vendor relationships; (v) Platform Pay receipts swept automatically into the SCSp operational account on a daily basis. Cross-border payment parameters: verify beneficiary IBAN/BIC via SWIFT/KYC utility before first payment, enforce a 24-hour hold on new beneficiaries, and escalate any deviation from the approved supplier list to the AML compliance officer.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD and EUR/CNH deliverable FX forwards with tenors up to 12 months, transacted under an ISDA or local FX master agreement with the clearing bank
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) limited to onshore CNY exposure where deliverability is legally constrained, with offshore USD settlement
Cross-currency swaps aligning structural EUR funding with USD trade receivables
Zero-cost FX collars or plain-vanilla FX options, subject to counterparty credit lines
All derivative activity confined to hedging of committed wholesale trade flows, preserving the SCSp's ancillary activity threshold and substance position under Luxembourg tax and ATAD rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RCSL Annual Declaration (déclaration annuelle) confirming registered office, general partner, limited partners and corporate information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCSL-LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month following each anniversary of the entity's RCSL registration date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing administrative fine up to EUR 750; persistent default may trigger RCSL strike-off, loss of registration standing and judicial winding-up

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO register annual confirmation declaration for ultimate beneficial owners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) via the Luxembourg Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of the initial RBE registration or of the most recent confirmation; any change of beneficial ownership must be updated within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 1,250; repeated non-confirmation blocks access to official UBO certificates and may be treated as administrative non-compliance leading to RCSL coordination and strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts / statutory balance sheet filing (only if the SCSp has legal personality, is a regulated AIF, or is otherwise required under the 1915 Law on Commercial Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RCSL-LBR for publication in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than seven months after the closing of the financial year, unless the management contract or partnership agreement shortens the period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within seven months exposes the SCSp and the general partner to coercive fines up to EUR 10,000 and strike-off proceedings after formal notice from RCSL

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Unregulated and tax-transparent SCSp is generally exempt from mandatory statutory audit because it lacks legal personality and is not required to publish annual accounts. A mandatory independent audit is triggered if the SCSp is constituted as or operates as a regulated alternative investment fund or securitisation vehicle, if the general partner is itself a Luxembourg commercial company subject to audit, or if the SCSp exceeds on a consolidating basis two of the following thresholds for two consecutive financial years: balance sheet total over EUR 4,400,000, net turnover over EUR 8,800,000, and average headcount over 50.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (implementing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU) for individual accounts; IFRS as adopted in the EU for consolidated accounts where applicable. A transparent SCSp must maintain adequate internal accounting records sufficient to determine each partner's share of profits and file such returns as required by the Luxembourg tax administration.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp must maintain an accurate register of all ultimate beneficial owners, defined as any natural person directly or indirectly holding or controlling more than 10% of the capital or voting rights, or otherwise exercising control over the partnership. An initial UBO declaration must be filed with the Luxembourg RBE within 30 days of RCSL registration. Any transfer of partnership interests or change of control must be re-filed within 30 days. Each year, within 30 days after the anniversary of the initial RBE registration, the SCSp must electronically confirm that the UBO data remains accurate, current and complete. The UBO register is not publicly open; inspection is limited to competent authorities and registered professionals under law.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,800 – USD 4,500 per annum for registered office, registered agent and RCSL filing representation in Luxembourg
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 – USD 9,000 per engagement for a modest SCSp where audit is required; no fee if audit exemption applies

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 17.00% (top marginal CIT rate for corporate partners; plus 7.00% solidarity surcharge and municipal business tax; aggregate effective top rate approx. 24.94% in Luxembourg City; SCSp itself is fiscally transparent and not subject to entity-level CIT)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: SCSp is pass-through: CIT applies at partner level. Available partner-level incentives and sector measures: participation exemption for dividends and capital gains (100%), IP box exemption for 80% of net qualifying IP income, 15% super-deduction for qualified R&D expenditure, investment tax credits for certain tangible assets, small business preferential CIT rate of 15.00% on first EUR 175,000 of taxable income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 470 (Déclaration pour l'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités et l'impôt commercial communal) submitted electronically via MyGuichet.lu / ACD e-Tax portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For financial years ending 31 December: return due by 31 May of the following calendar year. For non-calendar financial years: within five months of the financial year-end. Taxpayers represented by a certified Luxembourg accountant may obtain an administrative extension to 31 December of the following calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, address, Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register number, and ACD tax office reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporate partners must provide their foreign tax identification number and home jurisdiction; state whether the SCSp is applying for tax residence or relying on treaty PE protections.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit-and-loss detail for the wholesale distribution of eyeglass frames: turnover, procurement costs, commissions, warehousing, shipping, and administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the full Luxembourg-sourced commercial income attributable to the SCSp and allocate a pro-rata share to each partner in accordance with the partnership agreement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claims for participation exemption, IP box exemption, tax-loss carry-forward, ATAD interest-limitation carveouts, and any notional interest deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A transparent SCSp cannot itself claim corporate exemptions; only corporate partners may rely on these benefits after receiving the allocable share.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Municipal business tax and net wealth tax / Boxes 60–80
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of Luxembourg municipal business tax (impôt commercial communal) and net wealth tax exposure of the taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm whether the SCSp constitutes a permanent establishment in Luxembourg for treaty purposes and list the appropriate municipal coefficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annex L / Transfer pricing and intercompany transactions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance sheet, profit-and-loss attachment, and schedule of cross-border related-party transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose arm's-length pricing for purchases from overseas factories and sales to affiliated distributors, with TNMM/Resale Price comparables.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine up to EUR 10,000; default interest at 0.60% per month on the unpaid tax; arbitrary assessment by ACD where no return is filed; intentional non-disclosure may lead to a 15% uplift and criminal prosecution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ACD/RCS annual partnership information schedule (submitted electronically as Form 470 Annex P-1 via MyGuichet.lu; SCSp files separately from its corporate partners)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same statutory calendar as Form 470: by 31 May of the following year for calendar-year SCSp; extension to 31 December available with professional representation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, legal form, tax residence, ownership percentage, profit-sharing ratio, and capital contribution of each partner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporate partners must state their DTA treaty residence and provide current TRC references where treaty relief is sought.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocation of the SCSp's taxable commercial and passive income to each partner, including amounts of Luxembourg-source dividends, interest, and royalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the allocation to determine whether the non-resident partner is liable to Luxembourg CIT on a net basis through a PE or only to final withholding taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of cash distributions, debt-financing interest, and intellectual property royalties paid by or to the SCSp during the tax period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify all payments subject to Luxembourg dividend withholding tax, and provide supporting documentation for treaty-reduced rates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of Luxembourg-resident managers, physical office address, personnel, and operating expenditure attributable to the SCSp.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This section supports the partner's assertion of Luxembourg commercial substance, required to be effective for treaty protection and transfer-pricing audits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file an accurate partnership schedule: fines of EUR 100 to EUR 25,000; restitution interest of 3% per annum for unpaid amounts; partnership distributions may be recharacterised and treaty withheld tax refund claims disallowed.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15.00% standard Luxembourg domestic dividend withholding tax. Reduced to 0% for qualifying corporate shareholders holding at least 10% of the SCSp's capital for 12 consecutive months under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive and Luxembourg participation exemption. A transparent SCSp generally does not itself trigger dividend WHT; foreign partners are taxed on allocated income by local law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply treaty relief, the non-resident beneficial owner must submit a valid Tax Residence Certificate from its tax authority to the Luxembourg payer before the remittance date, together with the duly completed Luxembourg relief request (electronic via MyGuichet.lu or Form 22/23). The payer either withholds at the domestic rate subject to refund application, or obtains an ACD reduced-rate clearance certificate in advance. All claims must be filed within the statutory time-bar (generally by 31 December of the third calendar year following the tax year).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Luxembourg domestic law imposes a 0% withholding tax on interest and royalties paid to non-residents (subject to anti-abuse rules and payments to non-cooperative jurisdictions). Under Luxembourg tax treaties, interest and royalty payments are typically exempt or reduced to 0%–5%, provided the recipient is the beneficial owner and the payment is made at arm's length.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File for groups with consolidated turnover above EUR 50,000,000 where the annual aggregate of cross-border related-party transactions exceeds EUR 1,000,000. Mandatory Master File where the multinational group's consolidated turnover exceeds EUR 750,000,000. Country-by-Country Report is required for groups with consolidated turnover above EUR 750,000,000. Documentation must be contemporaneous, available within 30 days of ACD request, and prepared in line with the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg does not impose a formal UAE-style Economic Substance Regulation. Equivalent substance requirements are applied through the Luxembourg abuse-of-law doctrine, ATAD provisions (Articles 56bis LIR, 168a LIR), OECD MLI/BEPS Action 5, and the tax treaty beneficial-ownership test. An SCSp carrying on wholesale distribution of optical frames must demonstrate real management, local assets, decision-making, and risk control in Luxembourg to obtain treaty relief and to avoid being recharacterised as a letterbox conduit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing false Form 470/Form P-1 declarations, concealing partner identity, failing to report allocated income, or understating taxable profit by inflating intercompany costs in the eyewear distribution chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years for tax fraud; civil fraud penalty of 50% of the evaded tax; default interest at 0.60% per month; publication of the criminal sentence may be ordered.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the SCSp's general partner may be held jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax and penalties if they knowingly participated in the false filing; criminal conviction triggers travel bans and bar from future directorships in Luxembourg.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SCSp with no Luxembourg office, no local staff, no active bank relationship, and no management meetings, while passing large cross-border dividends or trade profits through Luxembourg tax treaties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ACD may recharacterise the SCSp as a Luxembourg tax resident corporate entity, deny DTA benefits, and impose back-tax CIT at 15%/17%, plus 7% solidarity surcharge, plus municipal business tax up to ~6.75% in Luxembourg City, with penalties of up to 50% of the reassessed amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: De facto or de jure directors who knowingly maintain a sham SCSp may be personally liable for the tax deficiency plus penalties; travel bans may be imposed during criminal investigation; imprisonment for abuse of law where intent is established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to register the ultimate beneficial owner of the SCSp with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register, or failure to conduct client/KYC due diligence on retail purchasers and platform pay counterparties receiving shipment proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to EUR 5,000,000 for legal persons under the Luxembourg AML law of 12 November 2004 (as amended); imprisonment of 3 to 10 years for intentional money laundering; suspension of the general partner's management mandate; seizure of banking assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines up to EUR 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years for AML infringements; conviction triggers a minimum 5-year ban on managing any Luxembourg legal entity and may include an international travel ban pending trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare contemporaneous Local/Master File, or carrying out intercompany wholesale pricing of acetate eyeglass frames at a mark-up of less than 1% on sales where the SCSp performs significant distribution functions and assumes inventory risk.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ACD transfer pricing adjustment to the taxpayer's taxable profit; administrative fine up to EUR 10,000 for documentation failure; additional 10% penalty on the amount of adjustment if the taxpayer's documentation is materially misleading; default interest from the original assessment date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are not strictly liable for TP adjustments, but may be personally responsible where they knowingly sign false intercompany agreements, inflate distributions, or cause the SCSp to use a sham pricing method to evade tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late Filing and Non-Payment of Withholding Tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to deduct the statutory 15% Luxembourg WHT on a deemed dividend distribution to a non-resident partner, or failure to remit the withheld tax to the ACD by the legally prescribed deadline.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monthly default interest of 0.60% on the unpaid WHT; late-payment surcharge of 10%; administrative fine of EUR 10,000 for failure to remit withheld tax; the ACD may procedurally deny the taxpayer's treaty-reduction claim.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorise the distribution without WHT deduction may be personally liable for the withheld amount and penalties; in the absence of SCSp assets, the ACD can enforce against the general partner's personal assets and impose travel restrictions.
